scientific_state.C0_feasibility_only: Compulsory evidence/identity/budget/recovery checks; not a B/C/G treatment comparison.
scientific_state.hidden_score: NOT_OBSERVED; not MAE0, poor performance, or utility floor.
scientific_state.programme_latency: NOT_OBSERVED; constructor/import/test/registration durations are preparation costs only.

synthetic_attempts.interpretation: One pre-controller fixture failure and one causally repaired synthetic-path pass. Not two identically distributed draws or 50-percent production reliability; no third attempt is implied.

operational_status.barrier_class: Before real programme admission; observed tool-interface and access constraints, not treatment-dependent failure.
operational_status.FG001: No documented verified long-episode composition that satisfies both mandatory nonblocking-turn return and standing no-background-across-turn rule.
operational_status.CUSTODY001: No actual original qualified scorer/service/controller process-capture chain. Static preflight does not certify OS origin.
operational_status.ACCESS001: Task-profile OAuth completion remains unconfirmed; repeated user continue acknowledgments are not evidence of login.
operational_status.scope: Do not infer ORX failure, an ML hypothesis failure, or impossibility of autonomous research in other authorized interfaces.

allowed: Exact source and file/identity contracts pass their cited synthetic controls
Specific reproduced failures and their bounded fixes
Source-faithful split prepared/content-verified under trusted host boundary
No supported execution composition verified under the current conjunction
not_allowed: Task efficacy or usable final artifact
Production reliability/rate from synthetic attempts or test counts
Graph advantage, no graph advantage, or architecture winner
Power/variance/sample-size estimate from one prepared task or two controller contexts

future_denominator_rule: If later admitted, append original programme/launch/outcome evidence with all attempted or unknown calls preserved. Do not rewrite this zero-start observation, silently reuse consumed authority, or delete failed partial evidence. Later missing scores stay missing under the frozen endpoint rule.
cost: Preparation/reviews/checks and failed attempts cost time and resources. Combined spend is not fully certified and must never be set to zero.
ancestry: P0 House Price source family remains development-only even though no task score was observed; no rename/re-split promotion into confirmation.
